name: Kudamatsu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kudamatsu city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised swirl of two strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kudamatsu, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kudamatsu city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised swirl of two strokes
